title: PaneReconnectParams
description: Press Reconnect on one pane (design §5.3, §5.6; nocx-oalo1.5.4). It is ONE backend call because whether and how a pane may reconnect is a connection fact, and ADR-ba6xet1b gives those one owner. The epoch is the one that carried the offer: a press about any other observation is about a connection state the person is no longer looking at, and the backend refuses it rather than opening a shell for a state that has moved on. The backend also refuses when no offer stands — a healthy connection has no button, and a button that was withdrawn cannot be pressed by a stale frame.

paneId.description: The pane whose connection is reconnected. It is the renderer's own durable id, the same one pane.connection is keyed by, and it must be a pane this connection opened: a pane somebody else opened has no offer this caller could be pressing.

connectionEpoch.description: The epoch from the pane.connection observation that offered the button. Monotonic per pane and minted at observation; a press carrying an older one is refused as stale.
